product_overview: LOKA provides an internal royalty operations dashboard for importing DSP reports, resolving exceptions, and controlling staged publication to creator accounts. Creators only see published or locked royalty statements, while admins manage review, approval, unpublish, and batch lifecycle from one interface.
core_goals: Import DSP royalty reports and review parsed distribution data before publishing
Resolve unmatched or conflicting royalty rows with required decisions and reasons
Control staged publication with checklist validation and two-person approval
Keep creator-visible royalty statements isolated to published or locked batches
Allow authorized rollback of a published batch when correction is needed

features.name: Admin Royalty Dashboard
features.description: An internal overview of royalty activity that shows key royalty totals, lets admins filter by period, and inspect creator-level results.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View total royalty totals and publication status summary -> Select a reporting period -> Search or sort the creator list -> Open a creator row to inspect details or statement

features.name: Creator Portal
features.description: A creator-facing view that shows only published or locked royalty statements, with period-based visibility and downloadable statement data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch to a creator account view -> Select a reporting period -> View the verification banner when the period is still under review -> Review gross and net royalty amounts -> Download the statement as CSV

features.name: Upload DSP Distribution
features.description: A workflow for importing DSP royalty reports, previewing parsed rows, and staging the data as draft for internal review instead of immediate creator visibility.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a DSP platform -> Upload a royalty report file -> Preview the parsed rows -> Run the distribution matching process -> See the draft confirmation that the batch is not yet visible to creators

features.name: Batch History & Staged Publishing Gatekeeper
features.description: A batch lifecycle control center for reviewing batch states, validating publishing readiness, approving publication with four-eyes control, unpublishing when needed, and closing periods.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review batch status badges -> Open the publish flow for a ready batch -> Verify the checklist and snapshot summary -> Select an eligible approver -> Confirm publication after accepting the declaration -> Review the batch as published

Navigate to / -> Open the unpublish flow for a published batch -> Enter a reason that meets the minimum length -> Review the affected creator information -> Confirm the rollback -> See the batch return to ready-to-publish status
Navigate to / -> Open a draft batch -> Choose to cancel the batch -> Confirm the cancellation -> See the batch marked as cancelled
Navigate to / -> Open a published batch -> Choose to close the period -> Confirm the lock action -> See the batch marked as locked

features.name: Exception Resolver
features.description: A workbench for handling unmatched rows and conflicts from DSP matching so batches can be cleaned up before publication.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Filter exceptions by failure stage -> Map an unmatched row to the correct song or creator -> Add a reason to put a row on hold -> Add a reason to ignore a row -> See the ready banner once all open issues are resolved

routes.description: LOKA Admin Royalti Dashboard with Sidebar Navigation (Dashboard, Creator Portal, Upload, Batches, Resolver)

features.name: Admin Royalti Dashboard
features.description: Royalty analytics overview with Tri-Metric Status Strip (PB-1.3), period filter, and creator table
user_interactions: View Total Potensi Royalti, Terpublikasi Resmi, and Pending Otorisasi
Filter royalty by period (Mei 2026, 1Q26, Semua)
Search and sort creator list
Click creator row to view details or statement

features.name: Creator Portal
features.description: Isolated portal for creators displaying only published and locked royalty statements with verification banners (PB-1.1 & PB-1.2)
user_interactions: Switch creator account view
Select period filter (Mei 2026, 1Q26, Semua)
View verification banner when period is in review or unverified (PB-1.2)
View gross and 70% net royalties
Download statement as CSV

features.name: Upload DSP Distribution
features.description: DSP royalty file parser and 3-stage matching engine importing reports as Draft (PB-4.5.3)
user_interactions: Select DSP platform (YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, Other)
Upload Excel or CSV report file
Preview parsed rows
Run 3-stage matching distribution engine
View Draft banner confirming data is not yet visible to creators

features.name: Batch History & Staged Publishing Gatekeeper
features.description: Batch lifecycle controller with Pre-Publishing Checklist, Four-Eyes approval, and unpublish rollback (PB-4.2, PB-4.3, PB-4.4, PB-4.5.1)
user_interactions: View status badges (Draft/In Review, Ready to Publish, Published, Locked, Cancelled)
Click Distribusikan to open Four-Eyes Publish Modal
Verify Gatekeeper checklist and snapshot checksum
Select approver (Finance / Head of Royalty) and confirm publishing
Click Tarik Kembali (Unpublish) with minimum 15 characters reason
Click Tutup Periode (Lock) to permanently close period
Click Batalkan Batch for draft batches
View audit logs for all batch events

features.name: Exception Resolver
features.description: Resolver workbench for unmatched DSP rows and song metadata conflicts
user_interactions: Filter by stage failure (Stage 1 Asset, Stage 2 Writer, Stage 3 Custom ID, Conflict)
Resolve unmatched rows by mapping to song or creator
Put rows on hold with mandatory reason
Ignore rows with mandatory reason
See ready banner when all open issues reach 0
